en.home.title: Live Stream Segmenter
en.home.about.title: 🔄 Stream beyond limits, preserve every moment
en.home.about.description: Live Stream Segmenter is a free, open-source, and automated plugin for OBS Studio that automatically segments your YouTube broadcasts to bypass the 12-hour archive limit. It uses direct YouTube API integration and customizable scheduling to create seamless transitions between segments, ensuring your entire streaming history is preserved for marathons or 24/7 events without manual intervention.
